actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Giorgia Meloni remains a dominant figure in the news cycle due to her ongoing public feud with former U.S. President Donald Trump. The dispute escalated after Trump claimed Meloni begged for a photo at the G7 summit, which she vehemently denied. This diplomatic spat has drawn international attention, with Meloni asserting Italy's sovereignty and defending her actions on the global stage. The situation has also sparked discussions about Italy's foreign policy and its relationship with the U.S.
